MiniMax-M3.description: NeuroLink default. OpenAI SDK page (https://platform.minimax.io/docs/api-reference/text-openai-api, retrieved 2026-09-29): "Frontier multimodal coding model with 1M context window", context window 1,000,000; the same page says "Image and video inputs are supported by MiniMax-M3.1-Flash-Preview and MiniMax-M3 through OpenAI-compatible message content parts", hence vision true. Chat Completions reference (https://platform.minimax.io/docs/api-reference/text-chat-openai): max_completion_tokens maximum 524288 for MiniMax-M3.1-Flash-Preview and MiniMax-M3. Pay-as-you-go pricing page (https://platform.minimax.io/docs/guides/pricing-paygo), Standard tab: "≤ 512k input tokens", $0.30 input, $1.20 output and $0.06 prompt caching read per M tokens (the page shows $0.60, $2.40 and $0.12 struck through beside them); "> 512k input tokens" $0.60 input, $2.40 output and $0.12 prompt caching read per M tokens (the page shows $1.20, $4.80 and $0.24 struck through beside them); both Standard rows carry the label "Permanent 50% off". The Priority tab says "Pricing is 1.5x standard." The pricingPerMTok figures are the Standard tab, "≤ 512k input tokens" row. Chat Completions reference thinking parameter: "adaptive thinking is on by default" for MiniMax-M3. Rate limits page (https://platform.minimax.io/docs/guides/rate-limits): RPM 200, TPM 10,000,000. The Integrate via SDK page (https://platform.minimax.io/docs/guides/quickstart-sdk) calls model="MiniMax-M3".

MiniMax-M3.1-Flash-Preview.description: OpenAI SDK page (https://platform.minimax.io/docs/api-reference/text-openai-api, retrieved 2026-09-29): "Frontier multimodal coding model with 1M context window and tunable thinking depth", context window 1,000,000; the page notes "MiniMax-M3.1-Flash-Preview is available only through Token Plan and MiniMax Code for now." and says image and video inputs are supported for this model, hence vision true. Token Plan overview (https://platform.minimax.io/docs/token-plan/intro): "The Subscription Key is not interchangeable with pay-as-you-go API Keys." Chat Completions reference (https://platform.minimax.io/docs/api-reference/text-chat-openai): max_completion_tokens maximum 524288, and the model "always thinks".

errorRules.message: MiniMax rejected the API key (HTTP 401, authorized_error). Check {apiKeyEnvVar}. Get one at {setupUrl}
MiniMax reports an insufficient balance (error 1008). The vendor's error-code table says: "Please check your account balance." (https://platform.minimax.io/docs/api-reference/errorcode)
MiniMax reports a rate limit (error 1002). The vendor's error-code table says: "Please retry your requests later." (https://platform.minimax.io/docs/api-reference/errorcode)

instructions: 1. Visit: https://platform.minimax.io/login?source=platform_docs and register or log in (https://platform.minimax.io/docs/guides/quickstart-preparation)

2. Pay-as-you-go: open API Keys > Create new secret key at https://platform.minimax.io/user-center/basic-information/interface-key and copy the API Key (https://platform.minimax.io/docs/guides/quickstart-preparation)

3. Token Plan: view your Subscription Key at https://platform.minimax.io/user-center/payment/token-plan. MiniMax-M3.1-Flash-Preview is stated as available only through Token Plan and MiniMax Code for now, and the Subscription Key is stated as not interchangeable with pay-as-you-go API Keys (https://platform.minimax.io/docs/api-reference/text-openai-api, https://platform.minimax.io/docs/token-plan/intro)

4. Billing as the vendor words it: "Pay-as-you-go uses standard Open Platform API Keys and consumes your account balance by actual usage." (https://platform.minimax.io/docs/guides/pricing-paygo) and "New users without subscription can try the free quota from Pay-as-you-go" (https://platform.minimax.io/docs/solutions/eigent, a tutorial dated January 23, 2026)
setup.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint at https://api.minimax.io/v1 (https://platform.minimax.io/docs/api-reference/text-openai-api sets OPENAI_BASE_URL=https://api.minimax.io/v1 and calls client.chat.completions.create), with the nine model ids in that page's Supported Models table in models.catalog. This entry is docs-verified only: an unauthenticated GET of https://api.minimax.io/v1/models answered HTTP 401 without a key, so the model ids come from the vendor's public docs and the roster has not been checked; it is not yet live-verified. That GET returned error.type authorized_error with the message "login fail: Please carry the API secret key in the 'Authorization' field of the request header (1004)" (2026-09-29), so errorRules match status 401 and the messages in the vendor's error-code table (https://platform.minimax.io/docs/api-reference/errorcode). models.defaultContextWindow (204800) and models.defaultMaxOutputTokens (65536) apply to ids outside the catalog: 204,800 is the context window the OpenAI SDK page lists for the MiniMax-M2.x models and 65536 is the recommended max_completion_tokens the Chat Completions reference gives for models other than MiniMax-M3.1-Flash-Preview and MiniMax-M3. capabilities.thinking is false and the entry sets none of the thinking, reasoning_effort or reasoning_split request parameters; the Chat Completions reference (https://platform.minimax.io/docs/api-reference/text-chat-openai) says of MiniMax-M3 "adaptive thinking is on by default" and of MiniMax-M3.1-Flash-Preview "always thinks". billingPolicy free-tier is the schema's closest value (the schema has no unknown value) and is not a MiniMax statement of terms; each model's status is likewise a value the schema requires (production, or preview for the id the vendor names Preview).
